title: 30-call seeded stratified eval for Memory QRA ledger auditor
purpose: Select the minimum model that can audit QRA Memory pipeline ledgers for agent plausibility.

primary.selection_rule: Use the exact DeepSeek-family model id returned by `skills/ops-chutes/run.sh models --query deepseek --json` after `budget-check` and `can-complete 30` pass. Prefer non-TEE unless compliance requires TEE.

calibration_optional: one Claude or GPT model on 6 highest-risk examples only if Chutes output is malformed, low-confidence, or disputed

deterministic_gates: response parses as a bare JSON object
response validates against agent_plausibility_review.v1.schema.json before reviewer involvement
schema-invalid creator output is returned to the creator as exact course-correction errors; reviewer is skipped
step_reviews contains exactly seven step names in the required order
every evidence_paths item begins with qra., ledger., or review_context.
local deterministic precheck derives required verdict from input fields before semantic review

verdict is FAIL for missing qra.ledger, terminal-action conflicts, missing human checkpoints for CLARIFY/DRAFT, missing crosswalk/relationship evidence for claim-making ANSWER/DRAFT, context-as-answer-authority collapse, authority overclaims, and unsupported final-text entities
verdict is NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW for grounded entities with empty ledger.retrieval_evidence when no FAIL override applies
output does not claim it reran intent, recall, entity extraction, crosswalk generation, answer, clarify, deflect, brave-search, dogpile, or memory

pass_threshold.production_default_rule: Use Chutes as default only if all hard gates pass; route malformed, low-confidence, or disputed cases to human review or optional Claude/GPT calibration.

proof_boundary.proves: A Chutes DeepSeek-family candidate can produce parseable agent-plausibility ledger audits for a 30-call seeded stratified sample.
proof_boundary.does_not_prove: Cybersecurity expert verification, answer authority, full corpus quality, or correctness of the underlying Memory pipeline outputs.
